purpose: Canonical registry for production TalkSys capabilities. Check this file before creating a new subsystem or version-suffixed source file.

runtime.entry.responsibility: Unversioned production HTTP entry point and terminal response authorization boundary
runtime.entry.migrationNote: The entry delegates normal request orchestration to worker-v44.js and applies the v46 hard-facts gate before user-visible factual output.

answer.authorization.responsibility: Final claim-level fail-close policy for exact transit routes and unsupported dynamic specifics
answer.authorization.migrationNote: Generic web retrieval may provide context but cannot authorize an exact transit sequence; structured route evidence is required.

grounding.policy.responsibility: Current factual/external lookup routing and contextual follow-up classification
grounding.policy.migrationNote: The older src/grounding-policy-v22.js contains useful prior logic but is not the current canonical production implementation.

answer.synthesis.responsibility: Top-level answer synthesis, grounded fallback behavior and user-facing sanitization
answer.synthesis.migrationNote: Grounded synthesis remains here; final factual authorization is enforced by src/entry.js.

search.execution.responsibility: Search provider execution, recovery queries, search budgets and evidence collection
search.execution.migrationNote: Retrieval changes should extend this capability rather than create another versioned search implementation.

search.planning.responsibility: Deterministic and model-assisted research planning for complex searches
search.planning.migrationNote: Director parallelization belongs here; do not create a second planner subsystem.

evidence.validation.responsibility: Current query/result evidence relevance gating during staged retrieval
evidence.validation.migrationNote: The older src/query-result-gate-v44.js is reusable prior art but is not the canonical production gate.

structured.tools.responsibility: Structured/free API intent detection and execution
structured.tools.migrationNote: Add supported structured sources through this capability and its companions before inventing a new router.

speech.stt.responsibility: Current speech-to-text path imported by the production worker
speech.stt.migrationNote: Legacy versioned filename; future replacement requires registry update.

ui.web.responsibility: Current web UI imported by the production worker
ui.web.migrationNote: Legacy versioned filename; future replacement requires registry update.

legacyPriorArt.src/grounding-policy-v22.js: Older grounding policy with contextual factual-risk logic; review before changing grounding behavior.
legacyPriorArt.src/query-result-gate-v44.js: Older standalone query/result relevance gate; review before extracting or redesigning evidence validation.
legacyPriorArt.src/search-orchestrator.js: Older deep-search orchestration path; review before introducing another orchestration layer.
legacyPriorArt.src/conversation-memory.js: Existing memory implementation; inspect before adding any new memory subsystem.
legacyPriorArt.src/search-rerank.js: Existing reranking implementation; inspect before adding another reranker.
